results.change_intent: Modify the statefulness check for form component fibers during transitions.
results.summary: Added a check for `existingStateHook.next !== null` that breaks reuse of the upgraded hook state and appears unintended given the PR's test-only description.

issues.comment: When `ensureFormComponentIsStateful` upgrades a form fiber, it creates a single Hook object whose `next` pointer is `null`. Requiring `existingStateHook.next !== null` prevents the function from recognizing an already-upgraded fiber, causing it to overwrite `formFiber.memoizedState` and its queue on subsequent submissions. Furthermore, this change conflicts with the PR description, which indicates the PR was only meant to add a test.
issues.suggestion: Revert this condition back to `if (existingStateHook !== null) {` so that already upgraded form fibers return their existing state hook.
